quest.title: The Night Before the Trial
quest.description: After resolving the Wingless's problem, you rush back to the trial site...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x475, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.num: Of Fading Flowers and Falling Feathers: Act II
chapter.title: The Night Before the Trial

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Oh, hey there, Chasca. Did Elder Allpa send you?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Yeah, she's got other things on her plate right now. How are things looking here?

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Hmm, well, the inspection revealed numerous blockages all over the trial arena. It looks like they're the result of ley line disorders caused by repeat Abyss invasions.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Theoretically, we just need to clear those obstacles, and the arena will fill up with gaseous phlogiston again. But that's proving difficult to achieve in practice, for all sorts of reasons...

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Why don't you head on down and check things out for yourself? Feel free to ask the staff for more details.

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: Oh, are you here to help? Thank goodness! There's no way I could do this all by myself...

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: The blockage here has to be cleared using a special bomb, but carrying explosives up that steep slope would be a recipe for disaster...

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: If I dropped it, or slipped and fell, I'd be blown to bits in an instant. So my plan was to transport the bomb to the other side, then send it over in a hot air balloon...

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: All I need now is for someone else to <color=#00E1FFFF>strike the balloon at the right moment, dropping the payload right on top of the spout...</color> and problem solved!

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: What do you think? Simple enough, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I can handle that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that hot air balloon up there yours, too?

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, THAT one... No, I've got no idea who that belongs to. Or how they got it up so high...

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: I just wish I could fly up there and check out what kind of tech they're using... Ah well, getting the trial arena back in order is more important.

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: I'll head over and set up now. Let me know when you're ready!

talks.objective: Clear out obstructions within the site

dialogues.speaker: Doubtful Investigator
dialogues.text: Whoa! Did you see that!? A tepetlisaur just showed up out of nowhere!

dialogues.speaker: Confused Investigator
dialogues.text: How did it get here? Just passing by, or...? Huh. Well, not gonna argue with a good thing. The spout's clear, that's all that matters...

talks.objective: Clear out obstructions within the site
Clear out obstructions within the site

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: Huh? Why'd you guys follow me? You won't get a good enough view from here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you go over the plan with me again?

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: Oh, sure. So, I'm gonna send the explosives over to the spout on the other side in a hot air balloon...

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: All you have to do is <color=#00E1FFFF>hit the balloon at the right moment, so the bomb falls right on top of the spout.</color> Simple!

talks.objective: Clear out obstructions within the site

dialogues.speaker: Cautious Investigator
dialogues.text: Hmm... I think it should be possible to clear this spout <color=#00E1FFFF>with just a few hard hits</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Cautious Investigator
dialogues.text: But there are signs of strange life in here... Meddling with it might be dangerous...

talks.objective: Return to the vantage point and talk to Inkanak

dialogues.speaker: Cautious Investigator
dialogues.text: Haha... I thought I was done for! This spout should be good now — thank you very much.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Wow, you took care of everything in no time at all... Incredible work!

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Now, we just have to wait until the gaseous phlogiston is fully replenished. Then we can kick off the retrials.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Hmm... Actually, Inkanak, I'd like to do a test flight first, just to make sure we're not missing anything. Could you arrange that for me?

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Huh? But... you only just finished getting the arena ready, there could still be other hazards we're unaware of...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: All the more reason to have me test it out. Think of it as another inspection.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Eh... I guess you're right — with your flying skills, you won't be in any serious danger, even if there are hazards we overlooked...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: The conditions in this area seem a little unstable, but a test-flight is the only way to catch any lingering issues.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll get things set up for you. Just let me know when you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Curious Investigator
dialogues.text: This is crazy... I put all of my strength into it, but it just won't break...

dialogues.speaker: Curious Investigator
dialogues.text: Maybe Inkanak was right after all... If a stable structure has formed inside the solid phlogiston, I'll need to hit all the weak spots at the same time to break it...

dialogues.speaker: Curious Investigator
dialogues.text: ...But how am I supposed to do that?

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Are you ready? This should be a piece of cake for Chasca, but still, try to be careful.

response.speaker: Inkanak
response.text: Alright, then spread your wings and fly!

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was amazing! Paimon couldn't take her eyes off you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, any further issues with the venue?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Hmm... No, nothing major. Give it a few days, and we should be able to conduct the trials.

dialogues.speaker: Isidore
dialogues.text: Help... Help me!

dialogues.speaker: Isidore
dialogues.text: ...You're from the Flower-Feather Clan, right? Please, come quick, you've got to help us!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Catch your breath first. What's the situation?

dialogues.speaker: Isidore
dialogues.text: W—We were... We got attacked, by a qucusaur!

dialogues.speaker: Isidore
dialogues.text: My friends are still stranded in the middle of the road with the goods we were transporting... Please, I'm begging you, save them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Are qucusaurs really that aggressive? Do they usually attack groups of people unprovoked?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Not in my experience... but there are exceptions to every rule. Let's go check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Doubtful Investigator
dialogues.text: How strange... why is there so much solid phlogiston here?

dialogues.speaker: Confused Investigator
dialogues.text: Could be from the Children of Echoes...? Maybe it got swept up here due to the Ley Line disturbances. <color=#00E1FFFF>And I did see those strange markings on the cliff...</color>

dialogues.speaker: Doubtful Investigator
dialogues.text: Ugh, I can't think of a way to resolve this... Short of going all the way to the Children of Echoes to borrow a <color=#00E1FFFF>tepetlisaur</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Allpa
dialogues.text: #Hm? Chasca, {NICKNAME}? This is a surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Elder Allpa? Huh? So... where's this aggressive qucusaur we've heard about?

dialogues.speaker: Allpa
dialogues.text: Already flew away. Looks like it backed off once it realized that reinforcements were coming.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: So why do you think it attacked these people in the first place? Was it after the food?

dialogues.speaker: Allpa
dialogues.text: No, these merchants aren't even transporting food...

dialogues.speaker: Young Merchant
dialogues.text: Ah! Thank goodness! The Phlogiston Wings are intact!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: ...Phlogiston Wings?

dialogues.speaker: Isidore
dialogues.text: Ahh, thank you so much for coming to our rescue. These Phlogiston Wings are our most prized goods. If anything happened to them, it would ruin us...

dialogues.speaker: Allpa
dialogues.text: ...Wait a minute, are you the merchants that were looking to collaborate with us? Warmi told me about you.

dialogues.speaker: Isidore
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's us! So... I take it you're Elder Allpa?

dialogues.speaker: Allpa
dialogues.text: I am. You must be exhausted from your journey, not to mention shaken up from the attack. Let me bring you back to our tribe to rest — we can talk business after you've recovered.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: But Elder Allpa, what about the qucusaur attack?

dialogues.speaker: Allpa
dialogues.text: Well, our guests here weren't seriously injured, and their goods are intact... Perhaps that qucusaur was just having a bad day.

dialogues.speaker: Allpa
dialogues.text: There are so many of them around here, you'd expect something like this every once in a while. I don't think we need to pursue it any further... More importantly, how are the preparations for the flying trials going? Is everything in order over at the arena?

response.speaker: Isidore
response.text: Huh? Did you say... flying trials? Wow, what a coincidence! Sounds like a perfect use case for our Phlogiston Wings! You'll be pleasantly surprised by what they can do!

response.speaker: Isidore
response.text: Hehe, well then let's forget all about this qucusaur attack for now... We have some serious business to discuss!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's it? That all went smoother than expected... Well, guess we'd better get going... Huh? Chasca?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The incident is forgotten about, and peace returns to the Flower-Feather Clan.\nThe next few days are uneventful — except for the flying trial preparations, which continue at an accelerated pace...

choices.text: The trials will be able to start very soon.

dialogues.speaker: Bold Investigator
dialogues.text: From this angle, you can see more clearly just how high up that hot air balloon is... I wish I knew whose it was.

dialogues.speaker: Curious Investigator
dialogues.text: Ahh, so THAT'S how you do it... Amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Young Merchant
dialogues.text: Ouch...

dialogues.speaker: Elderly Merchant
dialogues.text: I've never seen such an aggressive qucusaur...

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Why don't you head on down and check things out for yourself? Feel free to ask the staff for more details.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: The gaseous phlogiston is being replenished... Looks like all the spouts have been unblocked. Let's head back up.

dialogues.speaker: Young Merchant
dialogues.text: Ouch...

dialogues.speaker: Elderly Merchant
dialogues.text: I've never seen such an aggressive qucusaur...

dialogues.speaker: Cautious Investigator
dialogues.text: Haha... I thought I was done for! This spout should be good now — thank you very much.
